1.title: Is the Democratic Party Facing Its Own Tea Party Moment?
1.summary: A string of primary wins by progressive candidates has revealed the strength of a high-energy insurgent movement but also its potential limitations.

2.title: A Free-for-All in Alaska as 17 Candidates Compete to Be Governor
2.summary: Facing huge decisions, the oil-rich, cash-poor state will send four candidates to the final ballot in November. With so many candidates chasing so few voters, the hunt is intense.

3.title: Blanche Refuses to Say He’ll Always Be Independent of Trump as Attorney General
3.summary: The new head of the Justice Department said on “Meet the Press” on Sunday that the president had never asked him to prosecute specific people — and never would.

4.title: Two dead and evacuation under way as fires break out on Greek island
4.summary: Nearly 200 firefighters are trying to keep the two fires on Salamina apart, Greek media report.

5.title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
5.summary: Moscow also launched deadly strikes against Ukraine overnight, sparking fires across the capital Kyiv.

6.title: As Iran War Turns Into Economic Battle, a New U.S. Strategy Recalls Old Ones
6.summary: The United States and Iran are poised to blow past a deadline they had set themselves to broker terms on peace and Iran’s nuclear program.
